rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a person, performance, or speaker that is energetic and forceful.

example.english: This team plays with such dynamic energy that they keep the whole crowd engaged.
example.traditional: 呢隊波踢得好有活力，成場都帶動到觀眾。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 bo1 tek3 dak1 hou2 jau5 wut6 lik6 seng4 coeng4 dou1 daai3 dung6 dou3 gun1 zung3

rows.note: Choose this when the emphasis is on being active, involved, or lively rather than simply energetic.

example.english: The volunteers in this community are dynamic and always organize activities.
example.traditional: 呢個社區嘅義工好活躍，成日組織活動。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 se5 keoi1 ge3 ji6 gung1 hou2 wut6 joek3 seng4 jat6 zou2 zik1 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this for a situation or environment that is continually changing or variable.

example.english: Hong Kong weather is really dynamic; it can be sunny and rainy in one day.
example.traditional: 香港天氣真係多變，一日之內可以又曬又落雨。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 tin1 hei3 zan1 hai6 do1 bin3 jat1 jat6 zi1 noi6 ho2 ji5 jau6 saai3 jau6 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this when dynamic means able to adjust easily to new conditions or approaches.

example.english: When clients change their requests at the last minute, we need to be dynamic in handling them.
example.traditional: 面對客人臨時改要求，我哋要靈活處理。
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 haak3 jan4 lam4 si4 goi2 jiu1 kau4 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ling4 wut6 cyu2 lei5
